# netactuate_cloud_firewall_set_binding (Resource)

Manages a Cloud Firewall Set Binding.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_cloud_firewall_set_binding" "example" {
  firewall_set_id = 12345
  mbpkgid         = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_set_id` (Number) Firewall set ID to bind to the cloud server.
- `mbpkgid` (Number) Cloud server package ID to bind to the firewall set.

### Optional

- `interface_id` (Number) Server interface ID sent in the bind request.
- `set_priority` (Number) Firewall set priority sent in the bind request.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `raw_json` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by the bind call.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_cloud_firewall_set_binding.example 12345
```
